insights.title: The first two weeks after stopping a GLP-1 medicine
insights.summary: The medicine does not leave at once. Because of its half-life, some is still on board in the first two weeks.
body: According to the prescribing information, semaglutide has a half-life of about a week and tirzepatide about five days. Some medicine is still on board two weeks after the last dose, so the first fortnight can feel quiet.

Weight tends to come back after stopping. A 2026 meta-analysis found an average of 0.4 kg a month, and 0.8 kg a month in semaglutide and tirzepatide studies (BMJ, 2026). Individual courses vary widely.
That makes the first two weeks a good time to build a baseline. One weight and two appetite sliders a day let you compare the weeks that follow.

insights.title: Regain is not a willpower problem
insights.summary: Weight coming back after stopping is common in studies. Keeping records helps more than blaming yourself.
body: GLP-1 medicines are involved in regulating appetite and fullness. If hunger or food thoughts feel familiar again after lowering or stopping, it does not mean your willpower has failed.

Weight coming back after stopping is common in studies (BMJ, 2026). In real-world data, many people continued another treatment or lifestyle care with their clinician, and average regain a year later was small (Cleveland Clinic, 2026).
Blame yourself and stop logging, and you lose the thread. Look at weight and appetite side by side on Trends, and show those records at your next appointment.

insights.title: Thinking about restarting? Three records to bring to your appointment
insights.summary: Whether to restart is decided with your clinician. Three records make that conversation short and precise.
body: Whether to restart a medicine, and how, is decided with your clinician based on your health and other factors. Preparing records to show them helps more than deciding alone.
Three records are worth bringing: starting, lowest and latest 7-day average weight; appetite and food-noise scores from recent weeks; and your last dose date, dose and side-effect notes.
The Kept report puts these on one PDF page. The numbers and status labels in the app summarise your records; they are not a threshold for restarting.
